title: Travel Security in practice
intro: Protect your devices on every trip. Decide what you would do in each moment from this module's lessons.

decisions.title: Your booking is confirmed
decisions.prompt: On the road: safe or a trap?

artifact.subject: Your booking is confirmed
body: Check-in is after 14:00. Payment is made at reception.

decisions.explain: The hotel's own domain, no link, no payment request. A normal confirmation.

decisions.title: forum2026-materials.example.net
decisions.prompt: On the road: safe or a trap?

artifact.title: Scan to download the forum materials
body: You scanned a QR code: Scan to download the forum materials

decisions.explain: An .apk file installs an app on your phone. You do not need an app for slides, check the official site.

decisions.title: Your booking will be cancelled
decisions.prompt: On the road: safe or a trap?

artifact.subject: Your booking will be cancelled
body: Confirm your card details within 2 hours:

decisions.explain: A different domain and an urgent payment demand. Call the hotel yourself to check the booking.

decisions.title: Message from Forum Organising Committee
decisions.prompt: On the road: safe or a trap?

artifact.name: Forum Organising Committee
body: Dear delegate, to finish registration, send a photo of your passport and your room number here.

decisions.explain: Passports are collected on the official registration page, not in an anonymous chat. A room number reveals where you are.

decisions.title: Message from Lumera Hotel
decisions.prompt: On the road: safe or a trap?

artifact.name: Lumera Hotel
body: Welcome! Breakfast is 07:00 to 10:30 on the ground floor.

decisions.explain: No link and no request, just information.
